notes: Empty arg yields "What do you want to use?".
Item resolution is WEAR_HOLD then worn slots by keyword (FindEquippedVis), never inventory — matching C do_use SCMD_USE.
An equipped non-wand/staff yields "You can't seem to figure out how to use it.\nTry holding it.(?)".
Wand/staff spell casting via mag_objectmagic (Go DoUse casts, but its fidelity to mag_objectmagic is unverified). Phase-2 follow-up shared with quaff/recite.

Go "use <skill>" (CmdUseSkill) is a Go extension with no C do_use analog; kept intentionally. When nothing equipped matches, use falls through to it, so use <non-equipped-item> diverges from C's "You don't seem to have..." by design.
use tattoo routes to the tattoo path (use_tattoo); its own surface.
